Zulu: Ososayensi bathi ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuletha izinambuzane, izifo kanye nesomiso, okusongela ukukhiqizwa kokudla.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya sun ce sauyin yanayi yana haifar da ƙwari da cututtuka da kuma fari, waɗanda suke yin barazana ga samar da abinci.
Northern Sotho: Bašomi ba tša mahlale ba bolela gore phetogo ya tlelaemete e tliša diji, malwetši le komelelo, gomme se se tšhošetša tšweletšo yab dijo.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ የምግብ ምርትን አደጋ ላይ የሚጥሉትን ተባዮችን፣ በሽታዎችን እና ድርቅን፣ ያመጣል ብለዋል።

English: To try and reduce the impacts of climate change, scientists can improve the performance of crops through breeding or genetic engineering, to make them better at, for example, withstanding pests and diseases.
Luganda: Kale nno okugezaako okukendeeza ku kukosebwa okuva ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde, bannassaayansi basobola okwongera ku mutindo gw’amakungula g’ebirime nga bakozesa tekinologiya alongoosa mu nsigo, okuzifuula ennungi, okugeza nga zigumira ebiwuka n’endwadde.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbáyànjú láti mú àdínkù bá ipa yípadà ojú ọjọ́, àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì le è mú ìgbèrú bá ìṣesí àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn nípaṣẹ̀ iṣẹ́ òsìn tàbí ète iṣẹ́ ẹrọ ajẹmọ́ jíìnì, láti mú kí wọ́n túbọ̀ dára sí, fún àpẹẹrẹ kọ́ ojú ìjà sí kòkòrò àti àrùn.

Amharic: የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተፅእኖዎችን ለመሞከር እና ለመቀነስ፣ ለምሳሌ ተባዮችን እና በሽታዎችን መቋቋም የተሻሉ ለማድረግ፣ ሳይንቲስቶች በዘር ማራባት ወይም በዘረመል ምህንድስና አማካኝነት የሰብል አፈፃፀምን ማሻሻል ይችላሉ።

English: In this study, the researchers investigated why farmers would choose to use improved crops, and the benefits of using them.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonyereza ku nsonga ezireetera abalimi okulondako ensigo ennongooseemu, wamu n’emiganyulo egiva mu kuzikozesa.

Luganda: Baagamba nti kino kiyinza okuba nga kiva kuba nti tekinologiya omuggya yeetaaga abakozi abawerako, ate nga amaka amnene mubeeramu abantu bangiko abasobola okukola emirimu gy’omu nnimiro.

Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore se se ka ba ka lebaka la ditheknolotši tše diswa di hloka bašomi ba bantši, mola e le gore malapa a magolo ba na le batho ba bantši bao ba ka dirago mošomo wa bolemi.
Amharic: ይህ ሊሆን የቻለው አዳዲስ ቴክኖሎጂዎች ተጨማሪ ጉልበት ስለሚያስፈልጋቸው፣ እና ትላልቅ ቤተሰቦች የእርሻ ሥራ የሚሠሩ ብዙ ሰዎች ስላላቸው ሊሆን ይችላል ብለዋል።

English: Farmers who had more money and equipment were also more likely to use improved crops.

English: They also said farmers who could easily get agricultural information or knew about climate change were more likely to use improved crops.

Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ wípé, ó ṣe é ṣe fún àwọn àgbẹ́ tí ó rọrùn fún láti rí ìfitóniléti nípa iṣẹ́ àgbẹ̀ tàbí tí wọ́n mọ̀ púpọ̀ nípa àyípadà ojú ọjọ́ láti ṣe àmúlò àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn àmúdárasíi.

English: The researchers were surprised to find that farmers who knew about demonstration plots were less likely to use improved crops.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beewuunya okukizuula nti abalimi abaali bamanyi ku bifo ebiyigirwako baali balabika obutakozesa nsigo nnongooseemu.

English: Farmers use demonstration plots to teach, experiment, and share ideas about agricultural practices.

Hausa: Manoma suna amfani da filaye na nunawa don koyarwa da gwaji da kuma musayar ra’ayoyi game da ayyukan noma.
Northern Sotho: Balemi ba šomiša dipholoto tša pontšho go ruta, go dira ditekolo, le go abelana ka ga ditiro tša temo.
Amharic: ገበሬዎች ስለግብርና ተግባራት ለማስተማር፣ ለመሞከር እና ሀሳቦችን ለመለዋወጥ የሰርቶ ማሳያ ቦታዎችን ይጠቀማሉ።

English: When non-governmental organisations were used to teach farmers about improved crops, the farmers were more likely to listen to them.
Luganda: Ebitongole ebyobwannannyini bwe byakozesewa okusomesa abalimi ku bikwata ku nsigo ennongoseemu, abalimi baalabika nga basobola okubawuliriza.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí wọ́n bá ṣe àmúlò àwọn àjọ tí kìí ṣe tí ìjọba láti kọ́ àwọn àgbẹ̀ nípa àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn àmúdárasíi, ó ṣe é ṣe kí àwọn àgbẹ̀ tẹ́tí sí wọn.
Zulu: Lapho kusetshenziswa izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ukufundisa abalimi ngezilimo ezithuthukisiwe, abalimi babevame ukuzilalela.
Hausa: Lokacin da aka yi amfani da ƙungiyoyi masu zaman kansu don koya wa manoma game da ingantattun amfanin gona, manoma sun fi sauraren su.
Northern Sotho: Ge mekgatlo ye e sego ya mmušo e šomišwa go ruta balemi ka ga dibjalo tše di kaonafetšego, balemi go be go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore ba ka ba theeletša.
Amharic: መንግሥታዊ ያልሆኑ ድርጅቶች ለገበሬዎች ስለ የተሻሻሉ ሰብሎች ለማስተማር በጥቅም ላይ ሲውሉ፣ አርሶ አደሮች የማዳመጥ ዕድላቸው ሰፊ ነው።

English: This was because the organisations and farmers had worked together for many years, whereas demonstration plots are only set up for short times.
Luganda: Kiri kityo lwansonga nti ebitongole n’abalimi baali bakoledde wamu okumala emyaka, so ng’ate ebifo ebiyigirwako byo biteekebwawo kumala kaseera katono ddala.
Yoruba: Ohun tí ó fa èyí ni pé, àwọn àjọ náà àti àwọn àgbẹ̀ ti ṣiṣẹ́ papọ̀ fún ọdún pípẹ́, nígbà tí ó sì jẹ́ pẹ́ fún ìgbà díẹ̀ ní wọn gbé nípa ilẹ̀ oko àfiṣàwòkọ sílẹ̀ fún.
Zulu: Lokhu kwakungenxa yokuthi izinhlangano nabalimi base besebenze ndawonye iminyaka eminingi, kuyilapho izindawo zokubonisa zimiswa okwesikhashana.
Hausa: Wannan ya faru ne saboda ƙungiyoyi da manoma sun yi aiki tare na shekaru da yawa, yayin da ana shirya filayen nunawa na ɗan gajeren lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Se e bile ka lebaka la gore mekgatlo yeo le balemi ba be ba šomišana mmogo mengwageng ye mentši, mola e le gore dipholoto tša taetšo di hlongwa fela dinako tše kopana.
Amharic: ይህ የሆነበት ምክንያት ድርጅቶቹ እና አርሶ አደሮች አብረው ለብዙ ዓመታት ሲሰሩ፣ የሰርቶ ማሳያ ቦታዎች ግን የሚዘጋጁት ለአጭር ጊዜ ብቻ በመሆኑ ነው።

English: Farmers who had stayed in the village for many years and knew many people were more likely to use improved crops.
Luganda: Abalimi abaali babedde mu byalo okumala emyaka era nga baali bamanyi abantu bangi baali basobola okukozesa ensigo ennongooseemu.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe é ṣe kí wọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n ti gbé ní abúlé fún ọdún pípẹ́ tí wọ́n sì mọ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn ṣe àmúlò ohun ọ̀gbìn àmúdárasíi.
Zulu: Abalimi asebehlale iminyaka eminingi kuleli dolobhana futhi bazi ukuthi abantu abaningi bangase basebenzise izitshalo ezithuthukisiwe.
Hausa: Manoman da suka zauna a ƙauyen shekaru da yawa kuma sun san mutane da yawa sun fi yin amfani da ingantatttun amfanin gona.
Northern Sotho: Balemi bao ba dutšego metseng mengwaga ye mentši le go tseba batho ba bantši ba be ba na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya go šomiša dibjalo tše di kaonafetšego.
Amharic: በመንደሩ ውስጥ ለብዙ ዓመታት የቆዩ እና ብዙ ሰዎችን የሚያውቁ ገበሬዎች የተሻሻሉ ሰብሎችን የመጠቀም እድላቸው ሰፊ ነው።

English: If farmers used improved crops, they also made more money, said the researchers.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti abalimi bwe baakozesa ensigo ennongooseemu, era baakola ssente nnyingiko.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé, tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ bá ṣe àmúlò àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn àmúdárasíi, wọ́n a tún máa pa owó síi.
Zulu: Uma abalimi besebenzisa izitshalo ezithuthukisiwe nabo benza imali eningi, kusho abacwaningi.
Hausa: Idan manoma suna amfani da ingantattun amfanin gona, suna kuma samun ƙarin kuɗi, in ji masu binciken.
Northern Sotho: Ge e le gore balemi ba šomišitše dibjalo tše di kaonafetšego, le bona ba be ba dira tšhelete ye ntši, gwa bolela banyakišiši.
Amharic: አርሶ አደሮች የተሻሻሉ ሰብሎችን ሲጠቀሙ፣ የበለጠ ገንዘብ አግኝተዋል፣ ብለዋል ተመራማሪዎቹ።

English: They hope these findings will help authorities find ways to encourage more farmers to use improved crops.
Luganda: Basuubira nti ebyazuulibwa bino bijja kuyamba aboobuyinza okuzuula engeri z’okukubiriza abalimi abasingako okukozesa ensigo ennongooseemu.
Yoruba: Wọhn lérò wí pé àbọ̀ ìwadìí yìí máa ran àwọn alákòóso lọ́wọ́ lati wá ọ̀ná láti túbọ̀ gba àwọn àgbẹ̀ ní ìyànjú láti ṣe àmúlò ohun ọ̀gbìn àmúdárasíi.
Zulu: Bathemba ukuthi lokhu okutholakele kuzosiza iziphathimandla ukuthola izindlela zokukhuthaza abalimi abaningi ukuthi basebenzise izilimo ezithuthukisiwe.
Hausa: Suna fatan waɗannan sakamakon binciken zai taimaka wa hukumomi nemo hanyoyin da za su ƙara ƙarfafa gwiwar manoma da su yi amfani da ingantattun amfanin gona.
Northern Sotho: Ba holofela gore dikutollo tše di tla thuša ba taolo go hwetša ditsela tša go hloheletša balemi ba bantši go šomiša dibjalo tše di kaonafetšego.
Amharic: እነዚህ ግኝቶች ባለ ሥልጣናት ብዙ ገበሬዎች የተሻሻሉ ሰብሎችን እንዲጠቀሙ የሚያበረታቱበትን መንገድ እንዲያገኙ እንደሚረዳቸው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።

English: This study was done in Uganda, and the researches were based in Kenya, Uganda and Vietnam.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa mu Uganda, ate abanoonyereza baali bava mu kenya, Uganda ne Vietnam.
Yoruba: Uganda ni wọhn ti ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, Kenya, Uganda àti Vietnam si ní àwọn olùwádìí wà.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lwenziwa e-Uganda, kanti ucwaningo lwaluzinze eKenya, Uganda naseVietnam.
Hausa: An yi wannan binciken ne a Yuganda, kuma masu binciken suna zaune ne a Kenya da Yuganda da kuma Vietnam.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di dirilwe ka Uganda, gomme banyakišiši ba be ba le ka Kenya, Uganda le ka Vietnam.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት የተካሄደው በኡጋንዳ ሲሆን፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ ተቀማጭነታቸው ኬንያ፣ ኡጋንዳ እና ቬትናም ነው።
